convert_unispeech_sat_checkpoint: convert a fairseq UniSpeechSat checkpoint to a PyTorch HuggingFace model for CTC
convert_unispeech_sat_pretraining: convert a fairseq UniSpeechSat checkpoint to a PyTorch HuggingFace model for pretraining
load_conv_layer_weights: load conv layer weights from fairseq checkpoint into HuggingFace feature extractor layers
recursively_load_weights: recursively map fairseq model weights to corresponding HuggingFace UniSpeechSat model weights
set_recursively_assign_weights: recursively traverse HuggingFace model attributes and assign weight tensors by name
